notablePrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Sakashima of a Thousand Faces that enters the battlefield as a token copy of Orvar.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Orvar and the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token trigger, creating two token copies of Sakashima of a Thousand Faces that enters the battlefield as a token copy of Orvar.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting any Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
Orvar, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and the three Sakashima of a Thousand Faces tokens trigger, creating five token copies of the Island.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Activate four of the Island tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 7.
Once you have infinite mana, you can then target any permanent using Clockspinning to get infinite tokens of them.
